summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of ACASO Omniverse Round 3 features: Council of Weavers deliberation engine, Voice Chat + VoiceCommander, and Opportunity Radar with real public-opportunity discovery. All backend APIs and frontend UI components tested successfully.

backend_issues.notes: All 44 backend API tests passed (100% success rate). Live external APIs (Grants.gov, GitHub) working correctly. SAM.gov correctly reports not_configured as expected.

frontend_issues.notes: All 58 frontend tests passed. All 10 tabs load without console errors. VoiceCommander widget visible and functional on all tabs. Radar, Council, and Voice tabs fully functional with all UI elements rendering correctly.
